description: Open a Google Photos picking round for a connected Google Photos account (connectionId from oma_storage_import_list; optional with one account). Returns pickerUri for the user to open in their browser (pick up to 2000 photos and videos, then Done) and sessionId. Poll with oma_storage_import_photos_poll, then pass the sessionIds to oma_storage_import_start. Reads nothing and changes nothing at Google. For the whole library at once, Google Takeout (https://takeout.google.com) is better.
name: oma_storage_import_photos_pick
title: Pick Google Photos for Vault
